title.zh: 将卡米金次省从东米萨米斯省分离并设其为独立省的法案
title.en: An Act Separating the Subprovince of Camiguin from the Province of Misamis Oriental and Establishing it as an Independent Province
title.orig: An Act Separating the Subprovince of Camiguin from the Province of Misamis Oriental and Establishing it as an Independent Province

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 8 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1966/ra_4669_1966.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Subprovince of Camiguin is hereby declared separated from the Province of Misamis Oriental and constituted into a separate and independent Province of Camiguin.

The present territory of the Subprovince of Camiguin shall be the territory of the Province of Camiguin so established, and its capital shall be the Municipality of Mambajao. The provisions of the Administrative Code and other laws, insofar as they are applicable to a regularly organized province, shall apply to the government and operation of said province and to the election, appointment and remuneration of the officers thereof.
The elective provincial officials of the new Province of Camiguin shall be elected at the general election for local officials in November, nineteen hundred sixty-seven.

The Province of Camiguin shall have a Representative in the House of Representatives who shall be elected in the general election for such office in November, nineteen hundred sixty-nine: Provided, That the present Representative of the Province of Misamis Oriental shall, during his term of office as Representative, continue to represent the Province of Camiguin.

The funds and obligations and the property of all kinds owned by and/or to be assigned to the Subprovince of Camiguin shall, upon the establishment of the new Province of Camiguin, become the property of and/or be assigned to the latter.
The new province shall commence its corporate existence upon the election and assumption of office of the officials mentioned in Section three hereof.
All Acts or parts of Acts inconsistent herewith are repealed.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1966.
